svg.title: Lodge cutaway: walls cut at 1.2 m, viewed from the south-west
svg.desc: Axonometric cutaway of Common lodge with the roof removed and walls cut 1.2 m above the floor, showing Shared kitchen, Pantry and cold storage, Laundry, Mechanical and battery room, Gathering hall, Workshop and tool library, Washroom with shower, Universal washroom, Boot room, furniture, the envelope layers in the cut walls, screened porch and covered entry deck, ramps and piles. Concept only.
svg.text: Original concept | CC BY 4.0 | Eco Hamlet contributors 2026 | Concept only, not for construction
